footer: The test recognizes 0.6 seconds of silence and synthesizes two characters, which costs next to nothing.
model_asr1: 大模型流式语音识别 (streaming speech recognition 1.0)
model_asr2: 豆包流式语音识别模型2.0 (Doubao streaming speech recognition 2.0)
model_tts2: 豆包语音合成模型2.0 (Doubao speech synthesis 2.0)
need_key: Enter an API Key above and save it; saving tests it once.
steps: No key yet? In the Doubao Speech console, turn on 豆包流式语音识别模型2.0 and 豆包语音合成模型2.0 under 开通管理 (Activation), then copy a key from API Key管理 (API Keys).
why_busy: Volcengine's quota is used up, or too many sessions are running at once. Check what's left under 我的资源 (My Resources) in the Doubao Speech console.
why_failed: Volcengine had an error. Try again later.
why_forbidden: Volcengine refused this key. Copy a key again from API Key管理 (API Keys) in the Doubao Speech console, paste it and save.
why_network: Can't reach Volcengine. Check the network of the hub machine.
why_not_enabled: The key's project hasn't turned on {model} yet. Turn it on under 开通管理 (Activation) in the Doubao Speech console, then try again.
why_tts_not_enabled: The key's project hasn't turned on {model} yet. Turn it on under 开通管理 (Activation) in the Doubao Speech console, or turn off Read Answers Aloud if you don't need it.
why_voice: This voice can't be used. Pick another voice, or check in the console's 音色库 (Voice Library) that it's available to you.
